children: Bendigo & Adelaide Bank's bear at Macquarie sees little cause for optimism in the regional lender's latest update. One of the investment bank's analysts tells clients in a note that the 1Q update contained many moving parts, but that the underlying picture is one of disappointing revenue and weaker margins. With an unchanged underperform rating on the stock, the analyst expects ongoing headwinds from mix, as well as competition for both borrowers and savers. On top of this, Bendigo faces ongoing execution risks as it works to resolve regulatory issues. Jefferies lowers its target price 5.5% to 8.50 Australian dollars. Shares are down 0.7% at A$10.06. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
